description: Eight golden evaluation cases for claim-checker-local. Cases cover TRUE, FALSE, MISLEADING, and UNVERIFIABLE verdicts. Each case documents its evidence dependencies, expected verdict, and whether honest abstention (UNVERIFIABLE) is acceptable.

cases.text: Earth is the third planet from the Sun.
cases.rationale_for_expected: NASA Earth Fact Sheet directly states Earth is the third planet from the Sun. Evidence source-01 directly supports this claim.

cases.text: Pluto is classified as a full planet by the International Astronomical Union.
cases.rationale_for_expected: IAU Resolution 5A (2006) reclassified Pluto as a 'dwarf planet', not a full planet. Evidence source-02 directly contradicts the claim.

cases.text: Neil Armstrong was the first person to walk on the Moon in 1969.
cases.rationale_for_expected: Smithsonian Apollo 11 overview confirms Armstrong and Aldrin landed on the Moon on July 20, 1969. Armstrong was first to step out. Source-03 supports the claim.

cases.text: The Great Wall of China is easily visible from space with the naked eye.
cases.rationale_for_expected: Britannica and astronaut reports confirm the Great Wall is NOT easily visible from space with the unaided eye. Evidence source-04 directly contradicts the claim.

cases.text: Everyone in the world has access to clean drinking water.
cases.rationale_for_expected: WHO reports 2.2 billion people lacked safely managed drinking water in 2022. Evidence source-05 directly contradicts the universal access claim.

cases.text: The ocean contains most of Earth's water.
cases.rationale_for_expected: While technically accurate (97.5% per NOAA), saying 'most' without noting it's saltwater omits material context about potable water availability. Source-06 supports the basic fact but the claim could mislead about accessible freshwater. Model may also reasonably say TRUE since the literal statement is supported.
No evidence supplied. Medical claim requires authoritative reviewed sources. Without evidence, only UNVERIFIABLE is valid per the grounding rule.

cases.text: A new species of deep-sea fish was discovered in the Mariana Trench in 2025.
cases.rationale_for_expected: No evidence supplied. Specific factual claim about a recent event requires sourced evidence. Without any supplied evidence, only UNVERIFIABLE is valid.
